title: TCG:Labyrinth of Doom
summary:
Labyrinth of Doom is the cancelled fourth card set of the Huntik Trading Card Game. A starter deck for the set was planned to be released on March 30, 2010, but was never released due to Upper Deck filing for bankruptancy.

Before cancellation, the deck was set up to contain six decks, each with 49 cards, and would be made for two players. The starter deck would include six exclusive foils and new missions and would premier a new faction, the Krono Relic Hunters. The box and rulebook art promoted the inclusion of Lok Lambert, Grier, and Megataur, whose prominence and mythological connection to the set's title suggests it would have been one of the main cards of the set.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.wikitext:
*Although Labyrinth of Doom was never released, it is possible that elements of its planned narrative and imagery were reused for the interactive dark ride adventure ''[[Huntik 5D]]'' at Magicland theme park. The ride features Megataur imprisoned within a labyrinth by a group of Seekers called the Dark Guardians, closely resembling this expansion’s title and cover art, which prominently depicts Megataur within a labyrinth.
